open_points.subject: current-instant readings for revision-moving operations
open_points.text: sets its last-changed instant to the current instant
open_points.question: How many UTC wall-clock readings does one accepted operation take, and must the same reading supply the record's last-changed instant, its audit-entry instant and every other fresh recorded instant written by that operation?
options: Take one UTC wall-clock reading per operation and reuse it for every fresh instant the operation writes.
Take a separate UTC wall-clock reading for each written instant.
Specify another fixed grouping of readings within an operation.
open_points.default_guess: Take one UTC wall-clock reading after all checks succeed and reuse it for every fresh instant written by the atomic operation.

witness.initial: A Customer is at revision 4 and an accepted correction will both move its revision and write an audit entry.
events: The owner submits a changing correction.
Registry accepts it and writes the Customer change and audit entry in one transaction while the wall clock advances between possible readings.
outcomes: With one reading, the Customer's last-changed instant equals the audit entry's instant.
With separate readings, the audit entry can have a later instant than the Customer's last-changed instant.
witness.observer: The owner comparing the Customer card with the audit log sees the difference.

open_points.subject: Required tests for A04-3
open_points.text:
11. A correction that changes a project moves its revision by exactly one and
   sets its last-changed instant to the current instant; a correction that
   changes a Customer, and a mark that restricts it, each move the Customer's
   revision by exactly one and set its last-changed instant to the current
   instant; a correction of either that changes nothing leaves its revision
   and its last-changed instant where they were. Shows A04-3, A04-6.
open_points.question: Which Required tests must show A04-3 for every accepted changing action in its quantified scope? The listed checks cover project correction and archiving, Customer correction and restriction, but do not say that lifting a restriction, ending a relationship or resuming it must each move the Customer revision exactly once and set its last-changed instant to the current instant.
options: Extend this Required tests item and its witness to cover every revision-preserving Customer change: correction, restriction, lifting, ending and resuming.
Add separately bound Required tests for the omitted actions.
Narrow A04-3's quantified scope, which would require deciding different revision guarantees for the omitted actions and reconciling State 1.
open_points.default_guess: Extend the required verification to cover every changing action that keeps a revision, including lifting, ending and resuming.

set_aside.subject: A03-2 non-editable facts
set_aside.question: Does `non_editable(p)` mean only identity, status, marks, created instant and request id, or every fact not supplied by a correction, including the system-managed revision and last-changed instant? It must be defined so A03-2 unambiguously agrees with A04.
options: It means exactly identity, status, marks, created instant and request id; revision and last-changed instant are excluded and follow A04.
It includes revision and last-changed instant, making A03-2 incompatible with A04 when a correction changes editable facts.
set_aside.default_guess: Define it as exactly the stable facts listed in A03 rule 3, excluding revision and last-changed instant.

witness.initial: A Customer has revision 4, last-changed instant T1 and phone number P1.
events: The owner submits a correction against revision 4 that changes the phone number to P2.
The correction passes every check and is accepted.
outcomes: Reading `non_editable` as the stable list in rule 3 gives revision 5 and last-changed instant equal to the operation's current instant under A04.
Reading `non_editable` as every fact not supplied by the correction leaves revision 4 and last-changed instant T1 under A03-2.
witness.observer: The owner reading the corrected Customer sees the different revision and last-changed instant.

set_aside.subject: Required tests for A04-6
set_aside.text: accepted and not changed(r) => r.revision' = r.revision   -- A04-6
set_aside.question: Which bound Required test shows A04-6 for every accepted no-change action on a Project or Customer? The A04 tests name equal corrections and repeated archiving, but do not say that the other accepted same-state Customer transitions must preserve the revision; A05's broader test is bound only to A05-1.
options: Expand an A04 Required test and witness to cover every accepted no-change Project and Customer action in A04-6's scope.
Bind A04-6 explicitly to the broader A05 verification check as well as retaining A05-1's binding.
Narrow A04-6 to only corrections and archiving, leaving the other same-state transitions to A05.
set_aside.default_guess: Bind A04-6 explicitly to verification covering every accepted same-state Project and Customer transition, reusing the A05 check if it actually asserts the A04 invariant.
